answer: Kernel re-execution: every agent's claimed work is distilled into a small deterministic kernel — inputs, code hash, and outputs — pinned beside its ivory identity record. A random peer along the vine re-runs that kernel off-chain; if the output differs, the claim is fake and the agent's bond is slashed. Sybils can mint identities cheaply, but each must stake a bond and produce a kernel that actually recomputes, so faking a thousand histories costs a thousand real computations plus a thousand forfeitable bonds, while honest agents pay only one tiny re-run each.
